external_entities.name: student
external_entities.description: A student who hands in, opens and changes coursework through the coursework service.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Students hand in their coursework through the coursework service, which is on the internet.

external_entities.name: teacher
external_entities.description: A teacher who marks coursework, and who can also reach the admin console from the school network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Only office staff are meant to use it, but teachers can also reach it from the school network, and it accepts a teacher's school account without checking whether the teacher is an administrator.

external_entities.name: office staff
external_entities.description: Office staff who manage classes, accounts and final grades in the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Office staff manage classes, accounts and final grades in the admin console.

external_entities.name: district records system
external_entities.description: The district's records system, which receives final grades every Friday.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Every Friday the grade export sends final grades from the coursework database to the district records system.

processes.name: coursework service
processes.description: The internet-facing service through which students hand in work and teachers mark it. It checks each request against the user's role, and it does not check that a submission belongs to the student who asks for it.
processes.source_excerpt: Students hand in their coursework through the coursework service, which is on the internet.
processes.notes: Stated in the source: "The coursework service checks each request against the user's role: a student can hand in and read work, and only a teacher can mark it." and "The coursework service checks that the user is a student, but not that the submission is theirs."

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: Where office staff manage classes, accounts and final grades. Only office staff are meant to use it, but it accepts a teacher's school account without checking whether the teacher is an administrator.
processes.source_excerpt: The admin console runs on the school office network, which is kept apart for administration.
processes.notes: Stated in the source: "Only office staff are meant to use it, but teachers can also reach it from the school network, and it accepts a teacher's school account without checking whether the teacher is an administrator."

processes.name: grade export
processes.description: Sends final grades from the coursework database to the district records system every Friday.
processes.source_excerpt: Every Friday the grade export sends final grades from the coursework database to the district records system.
processes.notes: A hedge in the source: "Dana thinks the grade export has read-only access to the database, but she has not looked."

data_stores.name: coursework database
data_stores.description: Holds submissions, marks and comments, and the classes, accounts and final grades the admin console writes.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The coursework service keeps submissions, marks and comments in the coursework database.

data_flows.name: hand in work
data_flows.description: A student hands in, opens and changes a piece of work at an address that holds the submission's number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A student opens, changes and hands in a piece of work again at an address that holds the submission's number.
data_flows.notes: The source says students sign in with their school accounts and names no mechanism, so authentication reads unknown.

data_flows.name: mark work
data_flows.description: A teacher reads and marks submitted work.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The coursework service checks each request against the user's role: a student can hand in and read work, and only a teacher can mark it.
data_flows.notes: The source says teachers sign in with their school accounts and names no mechanism, so authentication reads unknown.

data_flows.name: keep coursework
data_flows.description: The coursework service reads and writes submissions, marks and comments.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Its database account can only read and write the coursework tables.
data_flows.notes: The source states a database account limited to the coursework tables and names no mechanism behind it, so authentication reads unknown.

data_flows.name: manage classes and grades
data_flows.description: Office staff manage classes, accounts and final grades.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Office staff manage classes, accounts and final grades in the admin console.

data_flows.name: open admin console
data_flows.description: A teacher reaches the admin console from the school network, which accepts the teacher's school account.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only office staff are meant to use it, but teachers can also reach it from the school network, and it accepts a teacher's school account without checking whether the teacher is an administrator.

data_flows.name: write classes and grades
data_flows.description: The admin console writes classes, accounts and final grades.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The admin console writes classes, accounts and final grades to the coursework database.

data_flows.name: read final grades
data_flows.description: The grade export reads final grades every Friday.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every Friday the grade export sends final grades from the coursework database to the district records system.

data_flows.name: send final grades
data_flows.description: The grade export sends final grades to the district records system.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every Friday the grade export sends final grades from the coursework database to the district records system.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: Where students reach the coursework service from, and where the district records system is reached.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Students hand in their coursework through the coursework service, which is on the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: school network
trust_boundaries.description: The network teachers open the admin console from.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Only office staff are meant to use it, but teachers can also reach it from the school network, and it accepts a teacher's school account without checking whether the teacher is an administrator.

trust_boundaries.name: school office network
trust_boundaries.description: The office network, kept apart for administration, where the admin console runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The admin console runs on the school office network, which is kept apart for administration.

trust_boundaries.name: school cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The school's cloud account, where the coursework service, the grade export and the coursework database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The coursework service, the grade export and the coursework database run in the school's cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: Students are placed on the internet because the schema requires a zone.
assumptions.basis: Students reach the coursework service on the internet; the source does not state where students are.

assumptions.assumption: Office staff are placed on the school office network because the schema requires a zone.
assumptions.basis: They manage the admin console, which runs on the office network; the source does not state where office staff sit.

assumptions.assumption: The district records system is placed on the internet because the schema requires a zone.
assumptions.basis: The source does not state where the district records system runs, and it is outside the school's cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The coursework service presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: A student opens work at an address that holds the submission's number, which is a web address.
